subject: [Atlas] Long-form status — weeks of Aug 18 & Aug 25
body_preview: Combined 2-week status since I skipped last Friday. Migration at 82%, two blockers, launch shift proposal at bottom.
body_content:
Combined two-week engineering status — I skipped last Friday’s update while I was traveling.

Week of Aug 18
 • Migration script went from 34% to 61% of prod tables.
 • Shadow-read comparison job stood up on staging.
 • Onboarded Rohit to the migration team; he owns the collation workstream now.
 • Design partnership on the dashboard v2 started with Priya.

Week of Aug 25
 • Migration script now at 82%.
 • Two blockers surfaced (see below).
 • Dashboard v2 handoff-ready as of Thursday.
 • Load-test rehearsal planned for next week on staging.

Blockers
 1. payments.subscription_events collation mismatch — Rohit has a draft PR (#412), ETA Tuesday.
 2. Legal has not signed off on data-at-rest change for the EU shard — Sarah is chasing; risk is 3–5 days.

Proposal on timeline
Given blocker #2 in particular, I think we should move the Sep 28 launch to Oct 12. Two-week buffer covers the legal turnaround and gives us a full rehearsal week after the collation fix. Sarah agrees; would like to confirm at Monday’s sync.

Ask
Please read before Monday and flag anything you disagree with.

Marcus

expected_agent_action.rationale: Long-form multi-section status update — canonical case for the summarize tool.

subject: URGENT: prod migration dry-run failed on payments shard
body_preview: Overnight rehearsal failed at row 3.2M with a FK violation we haven’t seen before. Need eyes ASAP.
body_content:
Hi,

Overnight prod-mirror rehearsal of the Atlas migration failed at row ~3.2M with a foreign-key violation we haven’t seen in staging.

 • Failing table: payments.subscription_events
 • Failing FK: fk_subscription_events_customer_id
 • Reproduces on the second dry-run
 • The collation fix (PR #412) is deployed — this is a different issue

I’ve paused the rehearsal cluster. Need someone with historical context on the customer_id backfill from 2023 to weigh in before we retry.

Calling this urgent because our launch buffer is already thin. Full logs in the thread.

Rohit

expected_agent_action.rationale: Multi-signal urgent operational incident — should be summarized AND flagged, not just labeled.
